response.answer: Your record says that uninterrupted morning drafting is materially associated with cleaner grants, while claims drafted across fragmented days cluster with office-action rejections. It also says an urgent morning filing is absorbable only when isolated, making repeated 9:15 intake interruptions a different condition. The later triage arrangement—paralegals running intake and attorneys consulted only after 11—restored your mornings cleanly. You can frame this as a reasoned request to protect claim-language precision, which you describe as the core economic value of your work, rather than as a refusal to handle intake. The rotation is set by the managing partner’s office, so your record supports requesting a reasoned exception or reassignment, not claiming unilateral control. Afternoon client calls appear compatible with preserving drafting work.
